methodology: Three fresh browser contexts per scenario with HTTP cache disabled, warm browser process and local production server; 3 s idle frame window, then 12 design switches (300 ms dwell), then post-GC heap/DOM measurement. First avatar is the first nonblank live preview canvas observed by rAF, including initial editor state before share options settle. Transfer sizes include document and loaded resources before switches. No performance pass/fail thresholds.
limitations: Mobile is Pixel 7 viewport/touch emulation on the desktop GPU, not a physical phone.
Loopback delivery is not deployment latency. Mobile uses 4x CPU slowdown, 1.6 Mbps down / 750 Kbps up, 150 ms configured latency.
CDP JS heap excludes GPU memory; three samples do not establish a leak or population performance.
rAF intervals measure browser scheduling, not individual avatar paint duration. GPU/shader caches can remain warm between contexts.
